_meta.notes: Typewritten 2006 form, fully legible; arithmetic closes.

contributions.detail: delta -1640.00 WITH A NAMED CAUSE, not filer arithmetic error: the 54 itemized rows sum to exactly 12,750.00, which equals the attachment's own printed 'Total Above $50  $12,750.00'. The filer then adds a summary line 'Total Below $50  $1,640.00' that has NO itemized rows behind it (sub-$50 contributions were reported only in aggregate), giving 'Total Raised $14,390.00' = the Summary Page line 1. The 1,640.00 is deliberately NOT emitted as a row - it is a total line, not a donor line.

expenditures.detail: exact (10154.71 = 10154.71); the 25 p5 rows sum to the cent and equal the attachment's own double-ruled 'Total Spent $10,154.71'

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: There is no 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' box on these attachments. The gates that FIRED: Schedule A pp.3-4 rows 12,750.00 = printed 'Total Above $50' 12,750.00 (exact); Schedule B p5 rows 10,154.71 = printed 'Total Spent' 10,154.71 (exact). The Schedule A side then reconciles to the Summary Page only after the un-itemized 'Total Below $50' 1,640.00 is added, which is why the side is recorded as a delta.
itemized.escalation_note: none needed: pp.3-5 are typed attachments read cleanly at 200 dpi and both printed totals closed to the cent
itemized.notes: 5 pages: p1 cover (DIANE TURNER, Democrat, Office Sought 'COUNTY COUNCIL' District 3; the SEPTEMBER 15 interim box is checked; amendment = No; signed 9/15/06; RECEIVED SEP 15 2006), p2 Summary Page (line1 $14,390.00 / Col B $22,109.23; line2 $10,154.71 / Col B $12,693.83; line3 $5,173.11; line4 $14,390.00; line5 $19,563.11; line6 $10,154.71; line7 $9,408.40 - the balance chain closes exactly), pp.3-4 Schedule A and p5 Schedule B, all three TYPED landscape attachments carrying their own 'Pg. N of 5 / Turner / 9/15/2006' headers. NOTE this is Diane Turner's OWN September-15 interim - not the Turner dissolution that the corpus records as misfiled under Deanna Taylor. The Schedule A Address column is blank (a faint clipped fragment at the head of each page suggests the street address was removed); City and State print in their own columns and are recorded. Four rows print no City at all. Schedule B's columns are Date | Description | Amount | Notes, so vendor comes from 'Description' and purpose from 'Notes'. Three in-kind items (SLCo Democratic Party voter file 125.00, Karen Okabe fundraiser food 300.00, Gastronomy Inc fundraiser food 1,600.00) appear on BOTH schedules - the form's own treatment of in-kind, not duplicates.
